rows.value:
AMD Ryzen 9000 / 8000 / 7000 Series Processors:
 
Supports Dual Channel DDR5 - 8000+(OC) MT/s, Non-ECC, Un-buffered Memory
 
4 x DDR5 DIMM Memory Slot, Max. Supports up to 256 GB Memory
 
Support Intel® Extreme Memory Profile (XMP) memory modules and AMD EXTended Profiles for 
Overclocking (EXPO) memory modules
 
* Please refer to www.biostar.com.tw for Memory support list.
